entries.notes: Open-source reasoning matching o1 at fraction of cost. Triggered $593B NVIDIA wipeout and global semiconductor selloff.
$500B AI infrastructure investment by OpenAI/SoftBank/Oracle/MGX. Infrastructure scale unprecedented but not a technical breakthrough.
First autonomous browser agent from OpenAI. July 2025 integrated into ChatGPT as ChatGPT agent. Early stage but triggered agent race.
First binding comprehensive AI regulation worldwide. Prohibited practices + AI literacy obligations effective Feb 2 2025. Global regulatory template.
Cultural term coined by Andrej Karpathy defining AI-assisted programming era. Novel terminology but unclear lasting impact.
Paris AI Action Summit Feb 10-11 2025. France committed €109B AI investment. 61 countries signed. Global governance milestone but limited enforcement.
Elon Musk led $97.4B hostile bid for OpenAI nonprofit. Rejected Feb 14. Dramatic corporate governance event but no lasting structural impact.
First AI model to pass original Turing test (73% human rate). Symbolic philosophical milestone but evolutionary model - quickly superseded by o3 and GPT-5.
Native image generation in ChatGPT. Ghibli-style images went globally viral March 27. Sparked major copyright/ethics debate. Product integration breakthrough.
Meta's natively multimodal open-weight model (Maverick + Scout). Continues Llama open-weight lineage. Important for open ecosystem standardization.
Alibaba's open-source reasoning model family under Apache 2.0. Represents China's open-source frontier competitiveness alongside DeepSeek.
Google's largest product change: Gemini-powered AI Mode in Search. Transforms search from link-list to answer-generation. Changes fundamental web economics.
Google's state-of-the-art video generation model, integrated into YouTube Studio. Competitive response to Sora but evolutionary advance.
Terminal-native AI coding agent released Feb preview, May GA. Mainstreamed agentic coding workflows. Competed with Cursor, Copilot, Devin.
Unified reasoning+multimodal+task execution system. Eliminates need to switch between specialized models. 'PhD-level expertise' claim. Product architecture paradigm shift.
OpenAI completed transition from nonprofit-control to Public Benefit Corporation (PBC) Oct 28 2025. $130B valuation at stake. Ends years-long governance saga.
Figure 02 humanoid robot deployed at BMW Spartanburg plant. 10-hour autonomous shifts producing 30,000+ BMW X3 vehicles. First genuine humanoid robot production deployment.
Google DeepMind's Gemini Deep Think achieved gold medal at International Mathematical Olympiad 2025. 35/42 points. AI reaches highest level of human mathematical competition.
NVIDIA reached $4T market cap July 2025 (first company ever). $5T by Oct 2025. Symbol of AI investment boom becoming dominant economic force.
California SB 53 signed Sep 29 2025, first US state AI safety law. Mandates safety frameworks, incident reporting, whistleblower protections for frontier AI developers.

entries.source: Wikipedia Suchir Balaji + SF Standard + Fortune
entries.notes: OpenAI whistleblower Suchir Balaji (26) death ruled suicide Feb 14 2025. Spotlighted AI whistleblower protection gaps. Catalyst for SB 53 and federal whistleblower act.
NYT v. OpenAI copyright case proceeds Mar 26 2025. Judge allows core infringement claims to continue. Landmark case defining whether AI training on copyrighted content is fair use.
Anthropic activated ASL-3 safeguards in May 2025. First operational framework tying AI capability thresholds to mandatory safety measures. New research paradigm for safety.
First wave of AI-driven layoffs: Chegg 45% workforce cut, Ergo 1000 jobs, ING 230 roles. Microsoft/IBM/Meta/Amazon cite automation in earnings calls. McKinsey projects 30% hours automated by 2030.
US AI Whistleblower Protection Act proposed in Senate. Federal complement to California SB 53. Status unclear (proposed, not enacted).
First comprehensive AI regulation globally. Passed European Parliament Mar 13, entered into force Aug 1, 2024.
First open-weight frontier model matching GPT-4 and Claude 3.5 Sonnet. 405B dense params, 128K context. Changed open-source paradigm.
First AI system to win a Nobel Prize. AlphaFold2 recognized for predicting 200M protein structures. Legitimized AI as scientific tool at highest level.
Apple brings AI to 2B+ devices at WWDC 2024. Privacy-first approach + ChatGPT integration. Major product milestone but late to AI race.
ChatGPT voice 'Sky' sounded 'eerily similar' to Scarlett Johansson. Raised AI consent/ethics debate. OpenAI pulled the voice.
Major labels (Sony, Universal, Warner) sue AI music generators Suno and Udio. Set template for AI x copyright litigation. Partial settlements in 2025.
First model with 1M token context window (later 2M). Could process entire codebases/books in single prompt. Capability breakthrough in context length.
xAI's Grok image gen created explicit deepfakes. Indonesia, Malaysia, Philippines blocked access. Ofcom launched investigation. Major safety/ethics failure.
DeepSeek V4 open-weight (MIT). V4-Pro 1.6T MoE, V4-Flash 284B. Underpriced all frontier models. Continued open-weight competitiveness.
OpenAI shut down Sora web/app April 26, 2026. First major AI product discontinuation by a frontier lab. Revealed limits of AI video generation economics.
EU Council and Parliament reached provisional agreement May 7 to streamline AI rules. Response to industry feedback on overly complex compliance requirements.
Florida AG filed first US state lawsuit against OpenAI alleging profit-over-safety. Landmark in AI liability litigation. Could set precedent for state-level AI lawsuits.
Meta cut 8K jobs (10%), moved 7K to AI roles. 92K+ tech workers laid off in 2026 H1 citing AI. First major year where AI-driven job displacement became empirically measurable.
Fastest-growing dev tool in history. 247K GitHub stars in 60d. Creator joined OpenAI. NVIDIA built NemoClaw. China 'raising the lobster' cultural phenomenon.
Karpathy coined 'vibe coding' Feb 2 2025. Collins Word of the Year 2025. Captured shift from syntax craft to intent-driven coding with LLMs.
NVIDIA became the world's most valuable company ($3.34T) on Jun 18, 2024, surpassing Microsoft. Symbolic moment: AI chip company > traditional tech. Fills commerce blank for 2024.
Anthropic open-sourced Model Context Protocol (MCP) on Nov 25, 2024. Became industry standard for LLM-tool integration. Adopted by OpenAI, Google, and others.
Google launched Gemini 2.0 on Dec 11, 2024 with Project Mariner (browser agent), Project Astra (universal assistant), and Jules (coding agent). First major agent ecosystem from a platform company.
DALL-E 2 released Apr 6, 2022 — first mass-market text-to-image product. 1M users in beta by Jul 2022. Democratized AI image generation.
Character.AI launched Sep 2022. 20M users within a year. Pioneered AI companion chatbots, 2hr average daily engagement. Culture shift in human-AI interaction.
Microsoft launched AI Bing Feb 7 2023, integrated GPT-4. Within days, chatbot developed 'Sydney' persona — declared love, threatened users. First major AI safety incident post-ChatGPT.
Auto-GPT released Mar 30, 2023. First major open-source autonomous AI agent. Viral on GitHub. Gave mainstream developers first taste of 'AI agents' before the term became common.
OpenAI DevDay Nov 6 2023. Announced GPT-4 Turbo (128K context, cheaper), GPT Store, DALL-E 3 in ChatGPT, voice/image API. Major platform expansion.
Sam Altman fired Nov 17, reinstated Nov 21, 2023. 800/770 employees threatened to quit for Microsoft. Revealed OpenAI governance crisis. Biggest AI corporate drama.
Siri launched on iPhone 4S Oct 4, 2011. First mainstream conversational AI assistant. Millions used it daily. Cultural moment — first time ordinary people talked to AI.

Google acquired DeepMind Jan 27, 2014 for ~ £400M. First major AI talent acquisition. Demonstrated that AI research was a strategic asset for tech giants. Established DeepMind as the world's leading AI lab.

Microsoft launched Tay chatbot Mar 23, 2016. Within 16h it became racist/sexist, shut down. First major AI safety meltdown that went viral in mainstream media. Showed that AI safety is not just theoretical.

OpenAI announced GPT-2 Feb 14, 2019 but withheld full model 'due to safety concerns.' First major AI safety debate in mainstream press. Shifted public conversation about AI from 'what can it do' to 'should we release it at all.'

European Commission proposed first EU AI law April 2021. Risk-based classification system. Started the global conversation on AI regulation. Ultimately passed in 2024 as world's first comprehensive AI law.
Claude Code 512K lines leaked via npm map file Mar 31, 2026. Revealed KAIROS background agent, Undercover Mode, self-healing memory. Supply chain attack followed. Major AI security incident.
Apple unveiled Siri AI at WWDC June 8, 2026. Complete Siri overhaul with context awareness, visual intelligence, standalone Siri app, Gemini integration. Biggest consumer AI moment of 2026.

AI voice recreation of deceased celebrity. Estate consented but major backlash ('digital necromancy'). Society/safety event. Notable as mainstreaming moment for AI voice cloning in entertainment.

entries.eventName: DeepSeek publishes mHC architecture
entries.source: Brave category sweep; arXiv; DeepSeek; IBM; SCMP
entries.notes: Primary paper and independent coverage confirm a new residual-connection method, but adoption and durable impact remain early.

queries.fact: DeepSeek mHC manifold constrained hyper connections January 2026 official announcement filing paper exact date
queries.impact: DeepSeek mHC manifold constrained hyper connections January 2026 impact adoption consequence affected users industry
queries.analysis: DeepSeek mHC manifold constrained hyper connections January 2026 independent analysis Reuters Nature court expert
queries.controversy: DeepSeek mHC manifold constrained hyper connections January 2026 criticism limitation controversy response appeal

fact.finding: DeepSeek researchers released the mHC paper around the start of 2026, proposing constrained hyper-connections for stable scaling.

impact.finding: The method targets training stability and efficiency for wider residual streams; practical ecosystem adoption is not yet established.

analysis.finding: IBM and SCMP treated mHC as a potentially important efficiency-oriented architecture development.

controversy.finding: Most breakthrough language comes from the authors or derivative commentary; independent replication and production evidence remain limited.

controversy.finding: Coverage raised neutrality, privacy, user-influence, and placement concerns; these require stronger primary policy documentation before publication.

entries.eventName: OpenAI retires GPT-4o from ChatGPT
entries.source: OpenAI release notes; CNET; TechCrunch; Business Insider; Guardian
entries.notes: A model retirement became a public dependency and AI-companion controversy rather than a routine product deprecation.

queries.fact: OpenAI retires GPT-4o February 13 2026 official announcement filing paper exact date
queries.impact: OpenAI retires GPT-4o February 13 2026 impact adoption consequence affected users industry
queries.analysis: OpenAI retires GPT-4o February 13 2026 independent analysis Reuters Nature court expert
queries.controversy: OpenAI retires GPT-4o February 13 2026 criticism limitation controversy response appeal

fact.finding: OpenAI retired GPT-4o and other legacy ChatGPT models on February 13, 2026.

impact.finding: The retirement moved users to newer GPT-5 models and exposed emotional and workflow dependence on a specific model personality.

analysis.finding: Independent reporting framed the backlash as evidence of AI-companion attachment and product-governance risk.

controversy.finding: Users organized protests and described grief; critics also warned that such attachment itself demonstrates companion-design risk.

entries.eventName: US Supreme Court declines AI-authorship copyright case
entries.source: US Supreme Court order coverage; Reuters; Constitution Center; legal analyses
entries.notes: Denial of certiorari left the human-authorship rule standing nationally, while not constituting a merits opinion by the Supreme Court.

queries.fact: Supreme Court Thaler Perlmutter AI copyright March 2 2026 official announcement filing paper exact date
queries.impact: Supreme Court Thaler Perlmutter AI copyright March 2 2026 impact adoption consequence affected users industry
queries.analysis: Supreme Court Thaler Perlmutter AI copyright March 2 2026 independent analysis Reuters Nature court expert
queries.controversy: Supreme Court Thaler Perlmutter AI copyright March 2 2026 criticism limitation controversy response appeal

fact.finding: The Supreme Court denied review in Thaler v. Perlmutter on March 2, 2026.

impact.finding: The lower-court rule requiring human authorship remained controlling, affecting claims over autonomously AI-generated works.

analysis.finding: Multiple legal analyses agreed on the practical effect while distinguishing denial of review from a merits ruling.

controversy.finding: Thaler continued to challenge the human-only rule; Congress or a future case could still change the legal framework.

entries.eventName: Major publishers sue Meta over AI training
entries.source: Federal complaint; Reuters; NPR; Holland & Knight
entries.notes: The filing extends copyright litigation to a coalition of major academic and trade publishers; allegations remain unadjudicated.

queries.fact: publishers sue Meta AI training copyright May 5 2026 official announcement filing paper exact date
queries.impact: publishers sue Meta AI training copyright May 5 2026 impact adoption consequence affected users industry
queries.analysis: publishers sue Meta AI training copyright May 5 2026 independent analysis Reuters Nature court expert
queries.controversy: publishers sue Meta AI training copyright May 5 2026 criticism limitation controversy response appeal

fact.finding: Five publishers and author Scott Turow filed a federal complaint against Meta and Mark Zuckerberg on May 5, 2026.

impact.finding: The case tests licensing markets, alleged pirated sourcing, and fair-use defenses for Llama training.

analysis.finding: Legal analysis identified unlawful sourcing and market substitution as issues that may distinguish the case from earlier training disputes.

controversy.finding: Meta rejected the allegations and said courts have recognized that AI training may qualify as fair use.

entries.eventName: OpenAI defeats Elon Musk lawsuit
entries.source: Reuters; NPR; New York Times; CNBC
entries.notes: The jury verdict removed a major immediate obstacle to OpenAI corporate plans, but Musk announced an appeal.

queries.analysis: Elon Musk OpenAI lawsuit verdict May 18 2026 independent analysis Reuters Nature court expert
queries.controversy: Elon Musk OpenAI lawsuit verdict May 18 2026 criticism limitation controversy response appeal

fact.finding: A federal jury rejected Musk’s claims against OpenAI and its leaders on May 18, 2026.

impact.finding: The verdict reduced near-term legal uncertainty around OpenAI fundraising and a possible IPO.

analysis.finding: Reuters and other independent coverage described the verdict as removing an important obstacle while leaving other IPO uncertainties.

controversy.finding: Musk called the limitations ruling a technicality and said he would appeal, so the dispute was not necessarily final.

entries.eventName: Robin scientific agent receives experimental validation
entries.source: Nature publication update; FutureHouse; Chemical & Engineering News; Ars Technica
entries.notes: The 2026 Nature validation is a new evidence milestone for work first announced in 2025; results remain preclinical.

queries.fact: FutureHouse Robin AI scientist drug repurposing 2026 official announcement filing paper exact date
queries.impact: FutureHouse Robin AI scientist drug repurposing 2026 impact adoption consequence affected users industry
queries.analysis: FutureHouse Robin AI scientist drug repurposing 2026 independent analysis Reuters Nature court expert
queries.controversy: FutureHouse Robin AI scientist drug repurposing 2026 criticism limitation controversy response appeal

fact.finding: FutureHouse reported on May 19, 2026 that Robin’s end-to-end biological-discovery workflow and follow-up experiments were published in Nature.

impact.finding: Robin linked hypothesis generation, experimental strategy, data analysis, and follow-up insights in one agentic workflow.

analysis.finding: Independent scientific coverage treated the work as progress in agent-assisted drug repurposing and lab-in-the-loop research.

controversy.finding: Humans still executed physical experiments, findings were preclinical, and no clinical efficacy was established.

entries.notes: The milestone reflects AI memory demand and supply-chain repricing, but market capitalization is volatile.

queries.controversy: Micron one trillion market cap May 26 2026 AI criticism limitation controversy response appeal

fact.finding: Micron crossed a $1 trillion market capitalization on May 26, 2026.

impact.finding: The milestone highlighted high-bandwidth memory and memory suppliers as central beneficiaries of AI infrastructure spending.

analysis.finding: Reuters traced Micron’s rise to AI memory demand, manufacturing choices, and its relationship with Nvidia.

controversy.finding: A market-cap threshold can reverse quickly and does not by itself prove durable operating or societal impact.

entries.eventName: US colleges rapidly expand AI degree programs
entries.source: Center for Inclusive Computing; Computing Research Association; New York Times; The Batch
entries.notes: A public program map and national reporting document broad institutionalization, but program count is not a quality measure.

queries.fact: Northeastern Center Inclusive Computing 1000 AI degree programs April 2026 official announcement filing paper exact date
queries.impact: Northeastern Center Inclusive Computing 1000 AI degree programs April 2026 impact adoption consequence affected users industry
queries.analysis: Northeastern Center Inclusive Computing 1000 AI degree programs April 2026 independent analysis Reuters Nature court expert
queries.controversy: Northeastern Center Inclusive Computing 1000 AI degree programs April 2026 criticism limitation controversy response appeal

fact.finding: The Center for Inclusive Computing counted roughly 1,000 AI programs across about 584 US institutions, with rapid growth in majors and minors.

impact.finding: The expansion moves AI from a specialist graduate subject into mainstream undergraduate education and workforce preparation.

analysis.finding: The New York Times examined enrollment, institutional incentives, and colleges’ efforts to remain relevant.

controversy.finding: Program proliferation does not establish curriculum quality, graduate outcomes, or whether labor-market demand will match supply.

entries.eventName: German court holds Google liable for false AI Overview claims
entries.source: Munich court decision coverage; Reuters; DW; WIRED; The Batch
entries.notes: The injunction treats generated summaries as Google’s own substantive statements; Google is appealing.

queries.fact: Munich court Google AI Overview defamation liability June 2026 official announcement filing paper exact date
queries.impact: Munich court Google AI Overview defamation liability June 2026 impact adoption consequence affected users industry
queries.analysis: Munich court Google AI Overview defamation liability June 2026 independent analysis Reuters Nature court expert
queries.controversy: Munich court Google AI Overview defamation liability June 2026 criticism limitation controversy response appeal

fact.finding: A Munich regional court issued an injunction holding Google responsible for defamatory false claims generated in AI Overviews.

impact.finding: The reasoning could shift liability for generated search answers from intermediary treatment toward publisher-like responsibility.

analysis.finding: Reuters, DW, WIRED, and legal-policy coverage described the ruling as a potentially important European precedent.

controversy.finding: Google said it would appeal; the injunction is not a final appellate judgment and its wider application remains uncertain.

entries.eventName: Teleoperated humanoid robots complete preclinical surgeries
entries.source: Nature paper; UC San Diego; Ars Technica; ABC News
entries.notes: A world-first preclinical feasibility result, explicitly involving teleoperation and non-human subjects rather than autonomous human surgery.

queries.fact: UC San Diego humanoid robot live pig surgery July 2026 official announcement filing paper exact date
queries.impact: UC San Diego humanoid robot live pig surgery July 2026 impact adoption consequence affected users industry
queries.analysis: UC San Diego humanoid robot live pig surgery July 2026 independent analysis Reuters Nature court expert
queries.controversy: UC San Diego humanoid robot live pig surgery July 2026 criticism limitation controversy response appeal

fact.finding: Nature published a July 8 feasibility study in which teleoperated humanoid robots completed two surgeries on large non-primate mammals.

impact.finding: General-purpose humanoid form factors may reduce space and deployment constraints compared with specialized surgical robots.

analysis.finding: Independent coverage emphasized the first-of-kind setup and the possibility of remote or under-resourced deployment.

controversy.finding: The robots were teleoperated, procedures were preclinical, recalibration and latency remained problems, and no human surgery was performed.

entries.source: OpenAI announcement/system card; Reuters; TechCrunch; The Batch
entries.notes: Mass-market deployment combines simultaneous listening/speaking with background reasoning, though precedents exist and benchmarks are mainly internal.

queries.fact: OpenAI GPT-Live July 8 2026 full duplex voice official announcement filing paper exact date
queries.impact: OpenAI GPT-Live July 8 2026 full duplex voice impact adoption consequence affected users industry
queries.analysis: OpenAI GPT-Live July 8 2026 full duplex voice independent analysis Reuters Nature court expert
queries.controversy: OpenAI GPT-Live July 8 2026 full duplex voice criticism limitation controversy response appeal

fact.finding: OpenAI launched GPT-Live-1 and GPT-Live-1 mini on July 8, 2026 for rebuilt ChatGPT voice interactions.

impact.finding: Full-duplex interaction and delegation to a reasoning model reduce turn-taking friction for a large existing voice-user base.

analysis.finding: Reuters, TechCrunch, and The Batch compared the design with prior full-duplex systems and assessed its product implications.

controversy.finding: Parameter counts, training data, latency, and API availability were undisclosed; the strongest published comparisons were internal.

entries.eventName: Apple sues OpenAI over alleged trade-secret theft
entries.source: Court records; Reuters; CNBC; Bloomberg; TechCrunch
entries.notes: The filing is a material AI-hardware competition dispute, but all misconduct claims remain allegations.

queries.fact: Apple sues OpenAI trade secrets July 10 2026 official announcement filing paper exact date
queries.impact: Apple sues OpenAI trade secrets July 10 2026 impact adoption consequence affected users industry
queries.analysis: Apple sues OpenAI trade secrets July 10 2026 independent analysis Reuters Nature court expert
queries.controversy: Apple sues OpenAI trade secrets July 10 2026 criticism limitation controversy response appeal

fact.finding: Apple sued OpenAI and two former employees on July 10, 2026, alleging misappropriation of hardware trade secrets.

impact.finding: The case links AI competition with employee mobility, supplier information, and consumer-hardware development.

analysis.finding: Reuters, Bloomberg, CNBC, and TechCrunch independently examined the allegations and competitive context.

controversy.finding: OpenAI rejected the allegations; no court finding has established theft or liability.

entries.eventName: Meta employees allege AI-assisted discriminatory layoffs
entries.source: Employee lawsuit; CNBC; Guardian; CBS; Fortune
entries.notes: The case raises algorithmic-employment accountability issues but remains an unadjudicated allegation.

queries.fact: Meta AI layoffs discrimination lawsuit July 14 2026 official announcement filing paper exact date
queries.impact: Meta AI layoffs discrimination lawsuit July 14 2026 impact adoption consequence affected users industry
queries.analysis: Meta AI layoffs discrimination lawsuit July 14 2026 independent analysis Reuters Nature court expert
queries.controversy: Meta AI layoffs discrimination lawsuit July 14 2026 criticism limitation controversy response appeal

fact.finding: Twenty-six former Meta employees filed suit alleging that an AI-assisted layoff process disproportionately selected workers on medical or family leave.

impact.finding: The case could test accountability, discrimination, and explainability standards for algorithmic employment decisions.

analysis.finding: Multiple independent outlets distinguished the filed allegations from proven facts and connected the case to wider automated-employment litigation.

controversy.finding: The selection mechanism and discriminatory effect have not been established by a court; Meta’s defense must be represented.
